publication_default: IDs, offsets and spans; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA and is not republished wholesale

retrieved_with.user_agent: scientific-network-coursework/0.1 (academic research project; Wikimedia API etiquette followed)

rules: Every fetched document is stored once, immutable, with URL, parameters, retrieval time, revision ID and SHA-256.

openalex_abstracts.licence: CC0 (OpenAlex); redistribution of abstract text not assumed, see docs/source-policy.md
openalex_abstracts.selection: all core papers; papers without an abstract use the title only

wikidata_organizations.selection: v4 organizations with a ROR ID, matched on Wikidata P6782 only; no name matching

wikidata_researchers.reason: optional; exact ORCID/OpenAlex-ID matches only if time allows

wikipedia_organization_pages.selection: English Wikipedia lead section and infobox of pages linked from a matched Wikidata item; revision ID stored
